title: Ella Langley & Sienna Spiro, But No ADÉLA: A Closer Look at the 2027 Best New Artist Grammy Race
summary: With first-round voting over & nominations out next month, Katie & Keith are taking a closer look at the coveted category on the Pop Shop Podcast.
tags: Pop Shop Podcast - New Every Tuesday
contentText:
Grammy first-round voting wrapped up last week, on Oct. 22, and 2027 nominations will arrive on Nov. 16 — so it’s a good time to take a closer look at next year’s best new artist race and who might snag one of those coveted eight nomination slots.

On the new Billboard Pop Shop Podcast , Katie & Keith are looking at some of the likeliest nominees, including Billboard Hot 100 record-setter Ella Langley and British songstress Sienna Spiro, and why one big name won’t be included on Grammy ballots this year: newly minted pop hitmaker ADÉLA.

Listen to the full conversation below:

Also on the show, we’ve got chart news on how Olivia Rodrigo is back at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love , how Zach Bryan’s surprise new album young manhood and other donatable organs makes a big debut, and how a trio of tracks swoop into the top five on the Hot 100 for the first time.

The Billboard Pop Shop Podcast is your one-stop shop for all things pop on Billboard ‘s weekly charts. You can always count on a lively discussion about the latest pop news, fun chart stats and stories, new music, and guest interviews with music stars and folks from the world of pop. Casual pop fans and chart junkies can hear Billboard ‘s executive digital director, West Coast, Katie Atkinson and Billboard ’s managing director, charts and data operations, Keith Caulfield every week on the podcast, which can be streamed on Billboard.com or downloaded in Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast provider.
